text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meisho Doto clears ramp after ramp.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Cup, hm-hm-hmm. I'll turn
over a
sparkly new leeeaf, useful to
Opera O as I can
beee! ♪

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Uugh, but my time isn't getting any
better. Even
with all my practice...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And the reason for that is clear—she
lacks the will
to compete. It's more than
obvious now that her
pining over T.M.
Opera O will continue to hold us
back.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Doto, do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I give Admire Vega a wink. When
something
needs saying, it must be said.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe, what do you think I should do?
I'm
worried my running is falling behind
Opera O's
expectations...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Of course it is. Do you know why?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
It's because you dote on her too much,
and now
you're focusing on the wrong
opponent.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You'll... never get strong that way.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ayabe... what do mean by
opponent?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Doto. Who do you think you need to
beat?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Um... Special Week and Grass Wonder...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You're wrong.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Who is it, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I have to tell it to her straight—it's my

responsibility.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, um... do you know who... my
opponent
is?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?
choice_data_list: テイエムオペラオーだ
テイエムオペラオーだよ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The wind comes to a halt.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Opera... O...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um... are you sure you're not mistaken? I
mean...
I've won against her sometimes,
but...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: No, I think... it is. Opera O is my...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
She's not my rival. Opera O is my idol...
she's my
inspiration.
choice_data_list: 超えるべきライバルだ
超えるべきライバルだよね

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
You're wrong! You've gotten it wrong,
all wrong!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meisho Doto's rebuttals are filled with
agony,
desperately guarding what's
important to her.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
You and Opera O... You and Opera O
are the
only ones on my side, and that
will never change.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I've always... always admired Opera O... I've wanted to be just like her...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
She was the one who told me how
brightly I
shined. She gave me
confidence...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
If that's how you got your confidence,
Doto...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Then if Opera O was to disappear, it
would
disappear right along with her.
Are you fine with
that?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Your beloved Opera O—where do you
think her
radiance comes from?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
It's all down to her astounding level of

confidence. Opera O will never bow
down to
anyone over anything.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
You won't become any more confident
hiding
under the comfort of that
proverbial umbrella.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
That might have worked at the
beginning. But
now... the seasons have
changed.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ayabe...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
You'll find yourself driven to a corner if
you don't
change. Opera O's facing the
same dilemma.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
The generation before us is strong. You
have to
put pressure on Opera O, view
her as
competition, so that you can grow
together.
Otherwise, you two have no
chance.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure Opera O said something similar
in that
bygone summer.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Our footsteps could leave a mark on
history.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Or, we could fail to realize our dreams
and sink to
rock bottom.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
However you want things to be... is up to
you.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
It can't be... If... things don't change, I'll
return...
back to how I was in the past.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
To prevent that... I have to see Opera O
as an
adversary...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Nghh... I just can't. I'll do anything else...

anything...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Trainer, you know I can't bring myself to feel that way! You know iiit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I have to draw out Meisho Doto's true
feelings,
step by step, with attention
and care.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Uuugh... Well, that's...
choice_data_list: 昔の自分には戻りたくないよね？

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Uuuugh, I dooo... B-but...
choice_data_list: キラキラな自分になりたいよね？

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Repaying my... debts? Will I?
choice_data_list: テイエムオペラオーへの恩返しにもなる

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: ...But! But!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite her cowering beneath Opera O's
shadow,
she's made steady progress to
this point. Now's
the time for the last
push.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sure, Meisho Doto will likely never
"awaken" on
her own. But...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Huuuh? I haven't yet begun my growth
spurt?
Ohhhh...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Okay, I'll... do my best, step by step! It
might be
hopeless in the end, but I can
take things slow.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I've got a lot of growing to do, and that
includes
my heart... Ohhh...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I want to do more things that
will help
me grow.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
But... ohhh, how? My dash time isn't
getting any
shorter.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: One last lap, please! I have to figure this out... I just have to!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meisho Doto, in all her moments of
inexperience,
the countless times she's
been backed into a
wall...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's never given up on herself. Not
once.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That's why, even now...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Trainer...
choice_data_list: 君は強い。諦めたりできないよね？
貴方は強い。諦めたりできないよね？

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ngh! Sniff! Well, I... I... I!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I won't give up! I don't want to lose—even to Opera O!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Waaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We finally see Doto's desire to win break
through
her inferiority complex.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She may be a late bloomer, but that's
okay. As
long as she's got her roots in
the ground, she'll
keep on growing.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... I'll... tell her. I'll declare her my
rival.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'm scared that... this will change our
relationship.
But...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'll do it! I'll challenge Opera O! I... I
have to
change... for her sake as much as
my own!
